proposal.diagnosis: The sweep is dominated by discomfort contributions in fault and double-fault evenings where actions come almost entirely from the mask source. A smaller, single-step move on lambda_T is the most defensible lever given the measured positive trend and the absence of unserved or violation increases in the fault-family scenarios.
